meta.scope: Indonesia Batch 2 — Industrial production, foreign trade, energy, and additional core BPS/BI series. Continues the foundational layer with manufacturing, external trade, energy balances, and supporting macro/social products.

candidates.title: Monthly Production Index of Large and Medium Manufacturing
candidates.description: Monthly production index for large and medium manufacturing establishments by KBLI/ISIC subsector (base year 2010=100). Principal high-frequency indicator of industrial activity.

candidates.title: Directory of Manufacturing Industry (Direktori Industri Manufaktur)
candidates.description: Annual directory and frame of large and medium manufacturing establishments. Supports the statistical business register and sampling for industrial surveys.
candidates.notes: Frame and structural node for the manufacturing statistical system.

candidates.title: Indonesia Foreign Trade Statistics – Exports
candidates.publisher: BPS – Statistics Indonesia (source data from Customs)
candidates.description: Annual and higher-frequency export statistics by commodity (HS), destination country, province of origin and ISIC. Primary official measure of merchandise exports.
candidates.notes: Core external-trade node. Commodity composition (including resource exports) is central to Indonesia’s external profile.

candidates.title: Indonesia Foreign Trade Statistics – Imports
candidates.publisher: BPS – Statistics Indonesia (source data from Customs)
candidates.description: Annual and higher-frequency import statistics by commodity, country of origin and other classifications. Complements the export series for the full merchandise trade picture.
candidates.notes: Import-side counterpart to the export statistics.

candidates.title: Energy Balances of Indonesia
candidates.description: Annual energy balance covering production, conversion and consumption of energy by type. Supports energy-policy assessment and links to both domestic industry and export commodities (coal, gas, etc.).
referenced_by: National accounts and industrial energy analysis
candidates.notes: Key resource and industrial-energy node for a major energy producer and exporter.

candidates.title: Producer Price Index / Wholesale Price statistics
candidates.description: Producer and wholesale price indices that complement the CPI and feed into national-accounts deflators and industrial cost analysis.
candidates.notes: Price-side densification of the industrial and macro layer.

candidates.title: Agricultural statistics (production, food crops, estate crops)
candidates.publisher: BPS – Statistics Indonesia / Ministry of Agriculture related
candidates.description: Recurring statistics on food-crop and estate-crop production (including palm oil, rubber, cocoa, etc.), livestock and related agricultural indicators. Central to both domestic food security and major export commodities.
candidates.notes: Primary-sector node. Estate crops (especially palm oil) are a major uniqueness layer for later densification.

candidates.title: Education statistics (enrolment, attainment, literacy)
candidates.publisher: BPS – Statistics Indonesia / Ministry of Education related
candidates.description: Official statistics on school enrolment, educational attainment, literacy and related indicators, largely drawn from Susenas and administrative sources.
candidates.notes: Human-capital node linked to the large youth population and skills agenda.

candidates.title: Health and vital statistics (beyond census)
candidates.publisher: BPS – Statistics Indonesia / Ministry of Health related
candidates.description: Health-related statistics including morbidity, health-facility access, insurance coverage indicators and complementary vital-event data that sit alongside the census-based demographic parameters.
candidates.notes: Health-side densification of the social cluster.

candidates.title: Inequality statistics (Gini ratio and related)
candidates.description: Official Gini coefficient and related inequality measures derived primarily from Susenas consumption data. Published at national and provincial level.
candidates.notes: Distributional counterpart to the poverty node.

candidates.title: Monetary aggregates and banking statistics (Bank Indonesia)
candidates.description: Money-supply (M1, M2, etc.), credit, and related banking indicators published by the central bank. Core high-frequency monetary data.
candidates.notes: High-frequency monetary densification of the Bank Indonesia cluster.

candidates.title: Financial Stability Review (Bank Indonesia)
candidates.description: Periodic assessment of financial-system stability, risks and macroprudential conditions. Flagship stability publication of the central bank.
candidates.notes: Stability-narrative counterpart to the monthly SSKI data.
